Canvas Design System
nodes.rationale: Reference doc defining visual design philosophy, two-phase process, core principles, design movements, implementation guidelines, and output format.

nodes.label: Design Philosophy Creation
nodes.rationale: Phase 1 of the two-phase process: create an aesthetic movement expressed through form, space, color, composition, not layouts or templates.

nodes.label: Visual Expression
nodes.rationale: Phase 2: express philosophy through canvas artifacts at 90% visual / 10% essential text, museum-quality execution.

nodes.label: Visual Communication First
nodes.rationale: Core principle: information lives in design, not paragraphs; expressed via color zones, geometric precision, spatial relationships, visual weight.

nodes.label: Minimal Text Integration
nodes.rationale: Core principle: text as rare powerful gesture, never paragraphs, typography as visual element, small labels huge impact.

nodes.label: Expert Craftsmanship
nodes.rationale: Core principle: work appears meticulously crafted, master-level execution, product of countless hours.

nodes.label: Systematic Patterns
nodes.rationale: Core principle: scientific visual language of repeating patterns, perfect shapes, dense accumulation, layered elements.

nodes.label: Chromatic Language
nodes.rationale: Design movement: color as primary information system, geometric precision, Josef Albers interaction meets data visualization.

nodes.label: OKLCH Color Approach
nodes.rationale: Implementation color approach: limited 2-5 color palette, cohesive system, oklch color space for precision, each shade carries meaning.

nodes.label: Multi-Page Design Systems
nodes.rationale: Multi-page approach: shared color palette, consistent typography, related composition, visual language continuity, philosophical thread.

nodes.label: Execution Checklist
nodes.rationale: Quality gate: 90% visual / 10% text max, nothing overlaps, pristine margins, museum-quality master-level execution.

nodes.label: Dialog Focus Trap

nodes.label: Live Regions

nodes.label: Form Accessibility

nodes.label: WCAG Color Contrast
nodes.rationale: Color contrast requirements: AA 4.5:1 normal / 3:1 large text, AAA 7:1 / 4.5:1, use semantic muted foreground.

nodes.rationale: Motion and animation: respect prefers-reduced-motion, set animation/transition duration to 0.01ms, motion-reduce:transition-none.

Visual Hierarchy (3-Zone Rule)
nodes.rationale: Logo/value prop top, supporting message middle, CTA bottom

nodes.label: Safe Zones
nodes.rationale: Keep critical content in central 70-80% of canvas, avoid text/CTA within 50-100px of edges

nodes.label: CTA Rules
nodes.rationale: One CTA per banner, high contrast, bottom-right placement, min 44px mobile tap target, action verbs

nodes.label: Typography Rules
nodes.rationale: Max 2 typefaces, min 16px body / 32px headline, 4.5:1 contrast, max 7 words/line

nodes.label: Text-to-Image Ratio
nodes.rationale: Ads under 20% text (Meta penalizes), social covers 60/40 image-to-text, print 70pt+ headlines for 3-5m viewing

nodes.label: Print Specs
nodes.rationale: 300 DPI min (150 large format), 3-5mm bleed, CMYK, 1pt per foot viewing distance

nodes.label: Design Principles (3-Zone, Safe Zones, CTA, Typography)
PAS (Problem-Agitate-Solution)
nodes.rationale: Moves audience from pain to remedy via problem, agitation, and solution

nodes.label: AIDA (Attention-Interest-Desire-Action)
nodes.rationale: Four-stage persuasion arc for CTAs and closing slides

nodes.label: FAB (Features-Advantages-Benefits)
nodes.rationale: Links product features to advantages and end-user benefits

nodes.label: Cost of Inaction
nodes.rationale: Creates urgency by quantifying loss from status quo and time decay

nodes.label: Before-After-Bridge
nodes.rationale: Frames transformation as pain before, desired state after, solution as the bridge

nodes.label: Duarte Sparkline Pattern
nodes.rationale: Alternating current pain with a better future creates engagement peaks at the 1/3 and 2/3 positions of a deck
